title: Reply Press
concept: A compact editorial print shop makes the limits of a technical reply tangible. Requirement and vendor fragments enter a cobalt mechanism, but the evidence feed has to be present before a draft can emerge. A missing reference leaves an actual gap, lowers a coral output stop and ejects a clarification fold. Linked evidence permits only a clearly marked draft. The last two scenes move away from machinery into a human review desk and an open archive, retaining original, change and rationale. All data, states and document fragments are illustrative; no engineering review or approval has been performed.
metaphor: An evidence-interlocked reply press: printing a draft is conditional; approving its meaning remains human.
choreography: Two differently angled document leaves approach a stationary press; an outlined evidence slot remains visibly empty.
An exploded three-feed composition aligns source strips into a wide roller while retaining a visible source trail.
The selected evidence state either lowers a physical output stop and unfolds a clarification request, or feeds a reference slip and releases a draft.
A large draft arrives beside its retained original; a red pencil underline asks the reviewer to check applicability.
The mechanism becomes an open archival folio, gathering original, change and rationale beside a draft awaiting human review.
interaction: The supplied missing/linked control directly changes phase 2: an empty evidence slot and blocked output versus an occupied feed and draft output. Neither branch asserts approval.
contributions: Pure SVG document and roller primitives reusable without browser APIs or dependencies.
A physical interlock visualization that makes missing-evidence withholding understandable without a dashboard.
Complete authored English/Korean text pairs with finite pausable motion and a complete static reduced-motion state.
limitations: All diagram data and review states are illustrative, not performed engineering.
The binary evidence choice does not assess relevance, completeness or applicability; those remain human judgments.
The compact artwork abstracts actual document contents and records no internal project data.
Verification is limited to Node syntax, pure rendering, SVG identifier scope and translation coverage; browser inspection is reserved for the host workflow.
